_readme: Market-test inventory (2026-09). Six co-living listings modeled on public for-sale listings in Charlotte, Charleston, and Jacksonville.
DATA ONLY — fed to scripts/seed-market-experiment.mjs. Adding these requires zero schema change (EXPANSION RULE).
Owner identification: every property and room carries the tag list in `ownerTags` (stored in prior_names, which nothing renders),
every property `address` is the real listing address, and docs/market-experiment-2026-09.md is the manifest.
Pricing: every room's weekly_rent comes from the BNHG Co-Living Profitability Worksheet model (benicehospitality/src/lib/resources/breakeven-analysis-worksheet/pricing.ts):
monthly = 65% of the comparable 1-bed rent + room premium (bath, size, parking, window) + property premium (laundry, kitchen, backyard, utilities, wifi, walk/transit/bike).
BNP tiers follow the production convention: weekly = monthly / 4 rounded to $5, monthly_rate = weekly x 4, daily_rate = round(weekly / 7), deposit $200, cleaning fee $0.
Photo files are listing photos held locally in scripts/data/market-experiment-photos/ (gitignored). See the copyright note in the docs manifest.

properties.name: Midwood Bungalow
properties.description: Midwood Bungalow is a furnished co-living home in Charlotte's Plaza Midwood, a 1920s house on a big corner lot with a rocking-chair front porch and a screened back porch. You rent a private room and share a well-kept house with a few other working adults, ten minutes from Uptown.

listingContent.hook: A front porch in Plaza Midwood, and Uptown ten minutes away.
listingContent.whoFor: Travel nurses, new hires, and anyone landing in Charlotte who wants a walkable neighborhood and a calm house to come home to.

rooms.name: Bright Corner Room with Parking
rooms.description: The largest of the three bedrooms at Midwood Bungalow, with big windows and a dedicated driveway space. The bathroom is shared across the house. A comfortable pick for a longer Charlotte stay when you're bringing a car.

listingContent.hook: The big room at the front of the house, with a parking space to match.
listingContent.whoFor: Someone staying a few months who wants natural light and a place to park.

rooms.name: Quiet Room with Parking
rooms.description: A furnished private bedroom at Midwood Bungalow with a driveway space of its own. It shares a bathroom with the rest of the three-bedroom house and sits off the main hall, away from the living room.

listingContent.hook: Your own quiet corner, a few steps from the screened porch.
listingContent.whoFor: Interns and professionals settling into Charlotte for a few weeks or more.

rooms.name: Budget Room on the Bus Line
rooms.description: The easy, budget-minded room at Midwood Bungalow: a furnished private bedroom with a shared bathroom and no parking space attached, which suits someone arriving without a car. CATS bus stops on Central Ave are a short walk.

listingContent.hook: The easy landing spot when all you need is good sleep and a short commute.
listingContent.whoFor: A working professional arriving without a car who wants a simple, affordable room.

properties.name: Dilworth House
properties.description: Dilworth House is a furnished five-bedroom co-living home on a tree-lined street in Charlotte's Dilworth, steps from East Boulevard and a short walk to South End. You rent a private room and share a renovated house with a few other working adults, with a deck, a flat backyard, and Uptown five minutes away.

listingContent.hook: A tree-lined Dilworth street, and the whole city on foot.
listingContent.whoFor: Hospital staff, relocating professionals, and anyone who wants to live in Charlotte's most walkable neighborhood without signing a year-long lease.

rooms.name: Primary Suite with Private Bath
rooms.description: The primary suite at Dilworth House: a large upstairs bedroom with an updated private bathroom, a walk-in closet, and the garage parking space. The room to take when you want a proper retreat at the end of a long shift.

listingContent.hook: The one with the door you can close and the bath that's only yours.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants real privacy and space for a longer or more focused stay.

rooms.name: Upstairs Room with Parking
rooms.description: A furnished upstairs bedroom at Dilworth House with a driveway parking space. It shares the upstairs hall bathroom with one other room and sits next to the laundry.

listingContent.hook: Upstairs, quiet, and a parking space with your name on it.
listingContent.whoFor: Professionals bringing a car who want a calm upstairs room.

rooms.name: Upstairs Room Near the Light Rail
rooms.description: A furnished upstairs bedroom at Dilworth House sharing the hall bathroom with one other room. No parking space attached, which suits someone commuting on the LYNX Blue Line, a short walk away.

listingContent.hook: Walk to the train, walk to dinner, come home to a quiet room.
listingContent.whoFor: Someone arriving without a car who wants the most walkable address in Charlotte.

rooms.name: Main-Level Room off the Den
rooms.description: A furnished main-level bedroom at Dilworth House, close to the kitchen and the den with built-ins. Shares the main-level full bathroom with one other room. No stairs, which some guests prefer.

listingContent.hook: No stairs, close to the kitchen, and the porch right outside.
listingContent.whoFor: Guests who want a ground-floor room and easy access to the shared spaces.

rooms.name: Main-Level Room by the Porch
rooms.description: A furnished main-level bedroom at Dilworth House with direct access to the porch and backyard. Shares the main-level full bathroom with one other room.

listingContent.hook: Coffee on the porch is a ten-second commute.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants a ground-floor room and outdoor space a step away.

properties.name: Montibello House
properties.description: Montibello House is a furnished five-bedroom co-living home on a corner lot in South Charlotte, with a backyard pool, a circular drive with room for everyone's car, and a finished basement with its own entrance. You rent a private room and share a big, quiet house with a few other working adults, ten minutes from SouthPark.

listingContent.hook: A pool out back, parking for everyone, and SouthPark ten minutes away.
listingContent.whoFor: Traveling professionals with a car who want space, quiet, and a real backyard rather than a downtown address.

rooms.name: Primary Suite with Private Bath
rooms.description: The main-level primary suite at Montibello House: a large furnished bedroom with its own full bathroom, hardwood floors, and a space in the circular drive. The most private room on the main floor.

listingContent.hook: A big main-floor suite with a bath that's only yours.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants privacy and space for a longer stay.

rooms.name: Main-Level Room with Parking
rooms.description: A furnished main-level bedroom at Montibello House with hardwood floors and a dedicated parking space. Shares a main-level full bathroom with the two other main-floor rooms.

listingContent.hook: A sunny main-floor room and a spot in the drive.
listingContent.whoFor: Professionals bringing a car who want a quiet, established neighborhood.

rooms.name: Main-Level Room by the Pool
rooms.description: A furnished main-level bedroom at Montibello House looking out toward the backyard and pool, with a dedicated parking space. Shares a main-level full bathroom.

listingContent.hook: Wake up to the pool, park in the drive, work from the basement office.
listingContent.whoFor: Remote workers and travelers who want outdoor space and a calm house.

rooms.name: Quiet Main-Level Room
rooms.description: A furnished main-level bedroom at Montibello House at the quiet end of the hall, with a dedicated parking space. Shares a main-level full bathroom.

listingContent.hook: The quiet end of the hall in a very quiet neighborhood.
listingContent.whoFor: Night-shift workers and anyone who values silence.

rooms.name: Basement Suite with Private Entrance
rooms.description: The basement suite at Montibello House: a large furnished bedroom with its own full bathroom, its own exterior entrance, a living room with a fireplace right outside the door, and a dedicated parking space. The closest thing to your own apartment in a shared house.

listingContent.hook: Your own door, your own bath, and a fireplace living room to yourself most nights.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants apartment-level independence with co-living pricing.

properties.name: Ponderosa House

source.fmvSource: RentCafe, West Ashley (Carolina Bay) 1-bed average, Aug 2026

properties.description: Ponderosa House is a furnished co-living home on a quiet cul-de-sac in Charleston's West Ashley, with an updated kitchen, a back deck, and a two-car garage. You rent a private room and share a well-kept three-bedroom house with a few other working adults, twenty minutes from downtown.

listingContent.hook: A cul-de-sac in West Ashley, and downtown Charleston twenty minutes out.
listingContent.whoFor: Travel nurses, Boeing and airport crews, and anyone new to Charleston who wants a calm house with parking.

rooms.name: Primary Suite with Private Bath
rooms.description: The main-level primary suite at Ponderosa House: a furnished bedroom with a walk-in closet, its own full bathroom, and a garage parking space. No stairs, and the deck is right out back.

listingContent.hook: Main floor, walk-in closet, and a bathroom nobody else uses.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants privacy and a ground-floor room for a longer stay.

rooms.name: Upstairs Room with Parking
rooms.description: A furnished upstairs bedroom at Ponderosa House with a dedicated parking space. Shares the upstairs full bathroom with one other room.

listingContent.hook: A quiet upstairs room and a spot in the drive.
listingContent.whoFor: Professionals bringing a car who want a calm base near the Greenway.

rooms.name: Upstairs Room over the Deck
rooms.description: A furnished upstairs bedroom at Ponderosa House with a dedicated parking space and a view over the back deck. Shares the upstairs full bathroom with one other room.

listingContent.hook: Upstairs, over the deck, with parking and a short drive to everything.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants a simple, comfortable room in a quiet neighborhood.

properties.name: Meeting Street Cottage
properties.description: Meeting Street Cottage is a fully renovated 1920s bungalow on the downtown Charleston peninsula, set up as a furnished co-living home with off-street parking, a new kitchen, and a stacked washer and dryer. You rent a private room and share a small, bright house with two other working adults, a short walk from Upper King Street.

listingContent.hook: Downtown Charleston on foot, and a parking space when you need it.
listingContent.whoFor: MUSC and hospitality staff, graduate students, and anyone who wants the peninsula without a peninsula lease.

rooms.name: Primary Room with Private Bath
rooms.description: The primary bedroom at Meeting Street Cottage: a furnished room with its own newly tiled bathroom and one of the off-street parking spaces. The most private room in a small downtown house.

listingContent.hook: A private bath on the peninsula, and a place to park.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants privacy downtown for a few weeks or a few months.

rooms.name: Cozy Room with Parking
rooms.description: A compact furnished bedroom at Meeting Street Cottage with an off-street parking space. Shares the second bathroom with one other room. Small, bright, and a few blocks from King Street.

listingContent.hook: Small room, big neighborhood, and your car off the street.
listingContent.whoFor: Someone who'll spend their days downtown and wants a clean place to land.

rooms.name: Cozy Room, Walk Everywhere
rooms.description: A compact furnished bedroom at Meeting Street Cottage for someone living car-free downtown. Shares the second bathroom with one other room; no parking space attached.

listingContent.hook: No car, no problem: King Street, MUSC, and the college are all on foot.
listingContent.whoFor: Students, hospitality staff, and anyone arriving without a car.

properties.name: Beauclerc House
properties.description: Beauclerc House is a furnished single-story co-living home in Jacksonville's Mandarin area, an all-brick house with a remodeled kitchen, floor-to-ceiling windows, a big fenced backyard, and an oversized garage. You rent a private room and share a refreshed three-bedroom house with a few other working adults.

listingContent.hook: One story, a fenced backyard, and parking for everyone in quiet Mandarin.
listingContent.whoFor: Hospital staff, relocating professionals, and anyone who wants a calm Jacksonville base with room to park.

rooms.name: Primary Suite with Private Bath
rooms.description: The primary suite at Beauclerc House: a furnished bedroom with its own full bathroom and a garage parking space, all on one level. The room to take when you want a door you can close and a bath nobody else uses.

listingContent.hook: Your own bath, your own garage spot, no stairs anywhere.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants privacy for a longer Jacksonville stay.

rooms.name: Sunny Room with Parking
rooms.description: A furnished bedroom at Beauclerc House with a driveway parking space, down the hall from the flex room. Shares the hall bathroom with one other room.

listingContent.hook: A bright room, a spot in the drive, and a backyard to spread out in.
listingContent.whoFor: Professionals bringing a car who want a simple, quiet room.

rooms.name: Quiet Room by the Backyard
rooms.description: A furnished bedroom at Beauclerc House at the back of the house, with a driveway parking space and the patio a few steps away. Shares the hall bathroom with one other room.

listingContent.hook: The quiet room at the back, with the patio right outside.
listingContent.whoFor: Anyone who wants an affordable room with outdoor space and easy parking.
